title: Table 9.01 Summary of the main features of BAP1-related tumour predisposition syndrome
tablehtml:
Feature

Syndrome characteristics

Syndrome MIM number(s)

614327

Associated malignant tumours

Uveal melanoma, mesothelioma, cutaneous melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, basal cell carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma

Associated benign tumours

BAP1-inactivated melanocytoma, meningioma

Cancer-related inheritance

Autosomal dominant

Chromosome location

BAP1 (3p21.1)

Protein product–associated pathway

BAP1 encodes a nuclear deubiquitinating enzyme that interacts with several chromatin-associated factors to orchestrate processes including gene expression, DNA replication, and DNA repair; nuclear localization and deubiquitination activity are both necessary for BAP1-mediated tumour suppression
